messages:
Jules: Quick shoutout — there are leftover salted pretzels + a box of mini chocolates in the kitchen that single-handedly saved my Tuesday. Who brought the salty-sweet combo?? :open_mouth:

Priya: That was Marco! He dropped them off right after the all-hands. absolute hero energy. :star2:

Marco: guilty as charged 🙂 wanted to celebrate the latency win on service-runtime. glad they hit the spot.

Samir: Huge shoutout to Marco for snacks and to Nina for staying late to help rollback staging — demo would have been toast without you. :raised_hands:

Nina: no prob! pair-debugging with Samir + Liam did the trick. team win.

Liam: agreed — Nina and Samir were clutch. also Belinda brought cupcakes that were dangerously good. :cupcake:

Belinda: planned it with @Jules and @Priya as a micro-celebration for the 3.2 deploy. tiny treats, big morale.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for service-api completed at 16:12 UTC — 0 errors :white_check_mark:

Tom: 👏👏 vote time: cake vs pretzels for next Friday snack run? :cake: vs :pretzel:

Jules: quick poll tally — cake 3, pretzels 2 so far. I'll put a note in the calendar and ping ops for supplies.

Priya: Nina, coffee on me tomorrow as thanks for the late-night triage. ☕️

Samir: sending a coffee voucher your way, Nina. you earned it.

Nina: saving that for Monday morning heroics. thank you all ❤️

Marco: if the runtime gods smile again, I'll volunteer as snack maestro. :sunglasses:

Belinda: love this — small wins and snacks keep us sane. :sparkles:

Liam: also +1 on a tiny emoji parade when deploy-bot gives us zeros on errors. :party_parrot:
